title.full: Applying for ComCare after SIRS refund

summary.text: You can apply if your household cannot afford basic living expenses. Contact an MSF Social Service Office.

steps.name: Contact an SSO
steps.text: If your household cannot afford basic living expenses, email Ask_SSO@msf.gov.sg, call 1800-222-0000, or approach the nearest Social Service Office.

example_phrasings: Can I apply for ComCare assistance if I have refunded my SIRS payout?
Can I get ComCare after returning SIRS money?
How do I apply for ComCare after a SIRS refund?

sources.page_title: Can I apply for ComCare assistance if I have refunded my SIRS payout?

quotes.text: Low-income households that are unable to afford their basic living expenses can approach MSF’s Social Service Offices (SSOs) to apply for ComCare.
If you need financial assistance, you may email Ask_SSO@msf.gov.sg, call the ComCare hotline at 1800-222-0000, or approach the nearest Social Service Office.
